legend.0: Needs a specific operating system feature, CI provider, package manager, hosting sandbox, or a flag the docs mark experimental or opt-in.
legend.1: Needs a named third-party package, an unusual character or syntax, or a precise sequence of actions such as interrupting a watch build at the right moment.
legend.2: Needs a documented option or a recognisable code pattern, in an otherwise ordinary build.
legend.3: Happens in an ordinary build with common options and ordinary code, with nothing unusual required to reach it.
